text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-j-e-c-t-e-d a-n o-t-h-e-r u-s-e-r-s s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n-s i-n-t-o a l-o-g-i-n f-l-o-w, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a b-r-o-t-h-e-r i-p a-d-d-r-e-s i-n t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-u-l-t-i f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-u-n-a-w-a-y a-u-t-o-m-a-t-i-o-n s-c-r-i-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a b-u-l-k t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n f-i-l-e i-n t-h-e p-a-y-m-e-n-t s-e-r-v-i-c-e l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e v-e-l-o-c-i-t-y l-i-m-i-t r-e-v-i-e-w
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-i-n-e-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n-t-o d-i-s-c-o-u-n-t c-o-d-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-c-k-i-n-g n-u-m-b-e-r i-n t-h-e r-e-d-e-e-m p-a-g-e r-e-c-o-r-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d s-c-o-r-i-n-g a-l-e-r-t r-e-v-i-e-w
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-e-g-a-n c-o-n-v-e-r-t-i-n-g b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n-t-o g-o-o-d-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a p-r-o-x-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-c-e a-b-l-e d-e-v-i-c-e i-p i-n t-h-e c-o-r-r-e-l-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-e-v-i-c-e f-i-n-g-e-r p-r-i-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d r-a-n-d-o-m a-n-o-m-a-l-y l-e-v-e-l c-o-n-t-e-x-t-s a-n-d t-i-m-i-n-g s-t-r-i-n-g-s t-o m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m p-a-t-t-e-r n i-n t-h-e r-e-p-o-r-t l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r b-a-s-e-l-i-n e c-h-e-c-k
